actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined immune/inflammatory identity with large effect sizes and very small q-values, supported by CNV alterations at known ccRCC loci. WXS mutation data are not FDR-significant but do not contradict the identity. Measured technical factors show no significant association after correction, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is better supported than Drop.
